fields.label: OCR Provider Mode
fields.description: Locked to Google Vision API for this deployment.

fields.label: OCR Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: How long to wait for Google Vision per page.

fields.label: OCR Low-Confidence Threshold
fields.description: A Daily Log row read with a confidence below this (0–1) is marked as an Exception under Validation Results and keeps the sheet in AI Review until the operator ticks OCR Review Complete.

fields.label: Google Service Account Key File (.json)
fields.description: Upload the .json key file exactly as downloaded from Google Cloud (Console -> IAM & Admin -> Service Accounts -> Keys -> Add key -> JSON), then Save. On Save the file is checked, its contents are stored encrypted in this site's database, and the uploaded file itself is deleted — so the key never stays behind as a downloadable attachment. The Cloud Vision API must be enabled, with billing, on that key's project. To replace the key, upload the new file and Save. After saving, use the Test Google Vision Connection button at the top.

fields.label: Google Key Loaded
fields.description: Which service account key is currently stored (never the key itself).

fields.label: Google Service Account Key (stored, encrypted)
fields.description: Internal storage for the key loaded from the uploaded file. Hidden on purpose: a visible Password box gets auto-filled by browser password managers.

fields.label: Keep OCR Word Dump
fields.description: Attach a small private JSON file to each sheet with every word Google Vision recognised and where on the page it was. Needed to diagnose and tune a misread sheet without paying for another Vision call.

fields.label: SAP Provider Mode
fields.description: Locked to Live for this deployment. The Mock path still exists in integrations/sap.py (kept as an offline fallback/reference) but is no longer selectable here — every validation run now calls the real SAP endpoint below.

fields.label: Mock SAP Scenario
fields.description: No longer reachable from the UI now that SAP Provider Mode is locked to Live — kept only so integrations/sap.py's Mock path still works if you ever re-enable it for offline testing.

fields.label: Response Contract
fields.description: Generic JSON expects {"checks": [{"code", "status": "Passed|Exception", "message"}, ...]}. Adjust log_sheet_automation/integrations/sap.py if your endpoint returns a different shape.

fields.label: Allow Duplicate Log Sheets (demo / testing)
fields.description: Normally a second log sheet for the same site, equipment, template and period is refused (business rule BR-004). Tick this ONLY on a demo or test site where the same sample scans are read again and again. Leave it off for real use.

fields.label: Notification Channel
fields.options:
None
Email
SMS
Email and SMS
fields.description: How to deliver the client approval link once generated. 'None' just returns it in the API response (demo behaviour).
